root_cause.text: The rsi driver fails to set `hw->vif_data_size` to `sizeof(struct vif_priv)`, causing the allocator to not allocate trailing space for vif driver data, yet the driver writes to `vif->drv_priv` as if it were allocated, leading to out-of-bounds memory corruption.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `hw->vif_data_size = sizeof(struct vif_priv);` to `rsi_mac80211_attach()`, and the CVE description explicitly states that the driver did not set vif driver data size, causing access to `vif->drv_priv` to corrupt adjacent memory.
